body: Instead of just showing empty list of chats we need to make that APP friendly for newbies. Meaning application should start by setting up connections to service providers. We should ever show instructions on how to export all the data from external profile and load it the app, or give enough credentials for each service provider to connect to API. We should try connect directly to API from the browser, if we encounter CORS error, we should give instructions on how to setup local server, without leaving the application, so users never forced to use GitHub, and web application give user enough information to work with and do everything. Instead of empty data, on each sections we have now - we should show ability to connect to providers, that supports these views. And guides for connecting of each provider and installation of local server for data storage and for proxying any requests to service providers. If we offline (not connected to local server, we still should be able to try to connect to service providers directly using web application), if we get CORS, we recommend add server. Even better if we add a tutorial layer for new users, that will show step by step how to use the application, so we can from the start reduce the need to support users and improve quality of software. Tutorial mode can be skipped (each step), and turn off completely, but it should be also possible from the UI to turn it back at any time. Make sure `docs/REQUIREMENTS.md` contain all these requirements, and we list requirements without any grouping by any issues. Just all the requirements ever recorded, should be there. And we need to make sure we try to fulfill them all as much as possible at the same time. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: We need to rework the UI, so we don't show sections with empty data
